# Introduction

This report provides a standardized survey of transcriptomic datasets (bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, and snRNA-seq) associated with Heart Failure with preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF).

# Metadata Dictionary

The repository consolidates biological metadata, experimental designs, and sequencing specifications to streamline bioinformatics workflows and comparative analyses.


```{python}
from hfpef_catalog.data_loader import load_all_species
from hfpef_catalog.processing import (
    count_all_species,
    sum_all_repositories,
    get_species_profile,
    dataset_count,
    tissue_count,
    sex_distribution,
    omics_approach_count,
)

# Carregamento inicial de todas as espécies
df_species = load_all_species()
total_species = count_all_species(df_species)
total_repo = sum_all_repositories(df_species)
```

# Repositories Details

```{python}
# Extração prévia dos dados de todas as espécies catalogadas: 

metrics_summary = {}

for species_name, species_df in df_species.items():
    metrics_summary[species_name] = get_species_profile(species_df)
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")

for species_name, metrics in metrics_summary.items():
    display_name = species_name.replace("_", " ").capitalize()

    print(f"## {display_name}\n")

    html_content = f"""
::: {{.columns}}

::: {{.column width="50%"}}
<div class="overview-card">
<p class="overview-label">Datasets catalogued</p>
<p class="overview-value">{metrics["dataset_count"]}</p>
</div>

<div class="overview-card">
<p class="overview-label">Sampled Tissue</p>
<p class="overview-value">{metrics["Sampled tissue"]}</p>
</div>
:::

::: {{.column width="50%"}}
<div class="overview-card">
<p class="overview-label">Strain / Ethnicity</p>
<p class="overview-value">{metrics["Sex distribution"]}</p>
</div>

<div class="overview-card">
<p class="overview-label">Omics Approach</p>
<p class="overview-value">{metrics["Omics approach"]}</p>
</div>
:::

:::
"""
    print(html_content)

print(":::")
```
